summary: Log bird sightings anywhere and build your life list.
page_description: A field-ready eBird companion for quick sightings, species lookup, life lists, and checklist sharing.
release_notes: Messages name the command that does the job, kobo fieldbook push or export, and the setup guide lists the steps.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Send a field pack of the species you expect to see.
Later, bring your outings back as an eBird checklist.
